# ANALYSIS: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE OOS Re-score with 3-4 DTE OPRA backfill

**Filed:** 2026-07-16  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** re-score  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Extending the DTE of the vwap_continuation signal from 0DTE to weekly options (3-4 DTE) may further reduce theta decay and increase edge_capture, building on the observed monotone increase from 0DTE ($36.34/tr) → 1DTE ($59.02/tr) → 2DTE ($66.13/tr). The 3-4 DTE OPRA backfill (~8k contracts) will allow measurement of expectancy and Sharpe for this longer horizon.

## Mechanism

Same directional signal (vwap_continuation) and same strike (ITM-2) as the original candidate. Entry uses the same signal trigger; exit uses the same -8% stop / +30% target. The only variable changed is DTE: we now evaluate contracts with 3-4 days to expiry using the newly backfilled OPRA data. Position sizing and risk rules remain unchanged (qty=28 for $25K+ account).

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper account would realize ~14% of headline P&L (same as base candidate).
2. **Sample bias:** Sample size ~8k contracts (3-4 DTE OPRA backfill). Selection method: all contracts meeting DTE 3-4 and the vwap_continuation signal criteria. Overfit risk: low because no parameter optimization is performed; we are measuring expectancy of a fixed rule.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (this analysis is the OOS re-score; result pending).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (validation on top 3 J days not yet performed).
5. **Failure modes:** Worst day: unknown; max drawdown: unknown; blow-up scenario: potential for adverse gap moves over multiple days increasing tail risk if stop is hit.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.

## Pre-merge gate

- Gym validators for the new DTE bucket must pass.
- Walk-forward OOS test must show positive expectancy and Sharpe > 0.70 (per OP-22 gate).
- Real-fills validation on top 3 J days must show <20% diff from BS-sim.
- Anchor no-regression: edge_capture must not decrease on J winner days.
